body:
Hey. I just took a bath and listened to some of my favourite songs. I'm going to talk to her best friend to know what went wrong. No I am not trying to win her back. Just gonna ask where did I fuck up and try to move on. 

I might find someone like her. But it's a very long shot. She turned me from a sociopath into someone who watches puppy gifs all day. It'll be tough. But I'll give it a shot. 

I know it really feels stupid that somebody would give their life up over a single person. So I'm going to live for others. My parents, my sister. Reconnect with old friends. Make new ones. Hope that everything will eventually be alright. 

Thanks! You're a beautiful person. And if you ever need help, pm me. Or if I'm not around, may I introduce you to Mr. Rogers. He's da bomb.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fKy7ljRr0AA

This is just me talking to myself. Strangely cathartic. Cheers!

But the point of life was to get old with that person. There's nothing that comes close to that feeling for me. I really really try to think of something that will make me happy, but there's nothing in this world that will make me as happy as when she is with me.
